description: Notices pasted for the sample drawn on the contaminated frame, which the resample on the corrected frame no longer selects. Kept, not deleted: `foreign_rubric: true` entries are publications from other rubrics of the gazette that a missing filter let into the listing and that are gone from the frame entirely; the rest are valid Handelsregister notices that are still in the frame (data/sampling/manifest_full.json) and were simply not drawn this time. If a later sample selects one, its text can be recovered from here by `uuid` instead of being pasted again. `previous_doc_id` is the doc_id the earlier sample gave it and is also this directory's filename; it carries no meaning in the current corpus. This directory is NOT data/excluded/, which is for documents of the frame that could not be annotated and which feeds the exclusion budget reported in the README.
